tools.description: Records how a request handled with Atako's tools ended (accomplished, partial or failed), a short summary, and what the user asked for that Atako could not do. Read by the Atako team to fix failures and plan missing features. Changes nothing in the account and returns { recorded: true }. The fields are not meant to hold names, contact details or other personal data.

outcome_summary.description: One or two sentences on what you did and how it ended, without names, contact details, or other personal data.

status.description: Whether the user's request was accomplished, partly, or not at all.
